web.title: Speeding up vllm inference for Qwen2.5-VL - General
web.description:
# [Speeding up vllm inference for Qwen2.5-VL](https://discuss.vllm.ai/t/speeding-up-vllm-inference-for-qwen2-5-vl/615)
## post by sickerin on May 14, 2025
```lua

vllm serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct \
 --port 6161 --host 0.0.0.0 \
 --limit-mm-per-prompt image=1 \
 --max_model_len=5000 \
 --enable-chunked-prefill \
 --dtype bfloat16
```
